text: Carpentry involves shaping and joining timber through exact methods. Sawing initiates the workflow, forming the core of every build. Clean edges and accurate dimensions depend on tools like circular saws. After cutting, planing and sanding follow to level surfaces and boost aesthetic quality. Smoothness remains vital for the final product's appearance and tactile experience. Various sanding approaches then refine the texture to secure a superior result. This text outlines the fundamental phases of carpentry practice.
